content: Browser markdown preview tools on developer catalogs (it-tools Markdown to HTML; mdutil/fwip/postcrest/achromatic) are live split-pane GFM (tables, task lists, strikethrough, fenced code) with copy HTML. Marked does not sanitize by default; DOMPurify.sanitize is the required XSS step. Mermaid/KaTeX/PDF export are extras, not table stakes. WYSIWYG editors and unsanitized innerHTML are anti-features.
